_comment: Data-driven blocking story card (docs/HudSystem.md section 11a; Ravenmere G-116). Loaded by UI::loadGameScreenInto(ui,"narrative",...) into narrative:<panel> screens while GameScreen is in ScreenState::Narrative. {{narrative.title}}, {{narrative.text}} (paragraphs joined with blank lines) and {{narrative.button}} resolve via MenuActions.onResolveVariable; the button's "continue" action fires MenuActions.onContinue - the host then starts (or resumes) whatever the card was gating, and also continues on Enter / Space. The text sits in a SCROLLABLE panel (narrative_body, 1000x460 at 140,130): text of any length wraps to 980 px and scrolls with the mouse wheel (the shell also scrolls it with Up/Down/PageUp/PageDown); a slim scrollbar shows when it overflows. The layout gate checks it at 3,200 chars. The button holds a 19-character caption. 1280x720 virtual canvas.
